source.title: TideLab existing channel rule coverage fixture

claim.attributed_summary: TideLab-authored synthetic conformance data for the source-attributed channel adaptation documented in docs/evidence/TL-003-CHANNEL-BREAKOUT-SYNTHETIC.md. No market-performance claim.
claim.economic_rationale: Fixture tests of prior-window breakout mechanics only; the external candidate interpretation is separately selected.

interpretation.product_scope: One synthetic spot-like instrument and cash; no market candidate is selected.
interpretation.timeframe: One closed synthetic hourly bar per decision, with a next-hour hypothetical fill.
required_data: TideLab-authored contiguous hourly actual open, high, low and close.
required_capabilities: Synthetic long/cash target and deterministic next-open fill contract.
interpretation.entry: Flat: close strictly above maximum high of prior 480 bars.
interpretation.exit: Held: close strictly below minimum low of prior 240 bars.
interpretation.sizing: 25% of signal-time cash; executable quantity follows the common manifest cost model.
interpretation.timing: 480 preceding warmup bars plus current close; next-open fill; no final signal or terminal sale.
